## Summary
Top keeper from vwap_overnight_grinder sweep shows wide_pnl=$587.72 over 12 trades (WR=83.3%) but anchor edge_capture=$40.01 (far below OP-16 floor of $771). Captures only 5/01 winner (+$40.01) while missing 4/29 and 5/04 winners entirely. Loser days show zero added loss (5/05: +$40.54, others $0) due to tight premium stop (-14%) converting potential losses to small gains. Performance driven by non-anchor days; anchor performance inadequate.

## (1) Genuine edge or overfit?
Overfit. Edge_capture on J anchor days is only 5.2% of the OP-16 floor ($40.01 vs $771 minimum). Wide_pnl concentration likely high (top 5 days probably exceed 100% of P&L) given only 2 profitable anchor days (5/01 and 5/05) contributing most returns. No evidence of structural edge on J's defined winner/loser days; performance appears driven by random non-anchor day fluctuations.

## (2) Which knob changes drove improvement vs baseline?
Baseline unknown, but combo parameters reveal:
- Extreme tight premium stop (`premium_stop_pct=-0.14` vs typical -50%) converts loser day losses to small gains (5/05: +$40.54) but likely whipsaws winners (only captured 40.01/470 on 5/01)
- Low `body_min_cents=0.05` allows noisy entries; short `lookback_bars=2` increases false signals
- `require_ribbon_agreement=true` + `ribbon_min_spread_cents=30.0` aligns with doctrine but insufficient to overcome noisy triggers
- `tp1_premium_pct=0.5` matches doctrine TP1 but profit-lock settings (`profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.1`, `profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05`) may prematurely exit runners
No clear improvement drivers; changes appear to overfit to non-anchor day noise.
